summary: Datasheet-verified cross-reference alternatives for LM2904DR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8, opamp-dual): evaluated 23 same-category OPNs and shortlisted the top 9 ranked replacements (0 Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, 9 Level 2 Tuning Required, and 0 Level 3 Layout Change). Verify pinout, thermal margin, lifecycle status, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

selection_checklist: Verify device class (opamp) and output stage (push-pull) — never substitute an uncompensated comparator for a compensated op-amp, or vice versa, without circuit redesign; only open-collector/open-drain outputs require an external pull-up.
Confirm supply rail span (3–26 V rec, 26 V abs max) and exact SOIC-8 pinout (1=OUT_A, 2=IN_NEG_A, 3=IN_POS_A, 4=VEE, 5=IN_POS_B, 6=IN_NEG_B, 7=OUT_B, 8=VCC).
Verify input common-mode headroom (Non-RR-In), output swing (Non-RR-Out), and Vos (7 mV max) against signal chain budget.
Check closed-loop bandwidth (GBWP / Acl), full-power slew rate (SR / 2π·Vpeak), and capacitive-load phase margin on the bench.
